items.title: Remove green-waste deposits from municipal land
items.quote: Ich fordere Sie gemäß § 14 OBG NRW auf, die Ablagerungen bis zum 20.01.2026 vollständig zu beseitigen.
items.computation: The letter states a fixed calendar date for compliance: 20.01.2026. This date is printed directly, so no further counting is needed. 20 January 2026 is a Tuesday, a normal working day, so it is not shifted.

items.title: File Klage (lawsuit) with the Verwaltungsgericht against the Ordnungsverfügung
items.quote: Die Klage muss binnen eines Monats ab Bekanntgabe des Bescheids schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift des Urkundsbeamten der Geschäftsstelle erhoben werden.
items.computation: Letter dated Tue 23.12.2025, sent by an authority by ordinary post: under § 41 Abs. 2 VwVfG it counts as delivered (bekanntgegeben) on the 4th day after posting, i.e. Sat 27.12.2025; this deemed-delivery day does not shift for a weekend. Counting the one-month period starts the next day under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB, so the month runs from 28.12.2025 and ends, per § 188 Abs. 2 BGB, on the day of the following month bearing the same number as the delivery day, i.e. 27.01.2026 (Tuesday). That day is a normal working day in NRW, so no further shift applies. The lawsuit must reach the court by this date.

warnings: The letter threatens 'Ersatzvornahme' (substitute performance) at an estimated cost of 480,00 € if the deadline of 20.01.2026 is missed, but this amount is not yet due and no payment is currently demanded.

The deemed-delivery date (27.12.2025, the 4th day after the letter's date) is an assumption based on the printed document date; if the letter was actually posted later or received later, the one-month Klage deadline of 27.01.2026 would shift accordingly — confirm the actual postmark or arrival date if possible.

No Widerspruch is possible here ('ein Vorverfahren entfällt') — the only remedy is filing a Klage directly with the Verwaltungsgericht Musterstadt; get legal advice (e.g. Verbraucherzentrale or a lawyer) well before the deadline if the person wants to contest the order.
